title.fr_fr: Fuselage long à combustible solide de taille 10

content.en_us:

- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 2 x [[gv:seg_10|Size 10 Connector]], 16 x Titanium Plate, 6 x Steel Plate - [[gv:schemas|blueprint required]]: Modular missiles.
- Crafting table : [[gv:mp_fuselage_10_long_solid_bullet|Size 10 Long Solid Fuselage]], Water Bucket.
- Crafting table : [[gv:mp_fuselage_10_long_solid_flames|Size 10 Long Solid Fuel Fuselage]], Water Bucket.
(3 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:mp_fuselage_10_long_solid_bullet|Size 10 Long Solid Fuselage]].
